object.attr: analysis: the blind tests found that the grid's editors save 314 for 3.14 typed into an integer, 1.23 for 1.2.3 typed into a real, and the current year for 0001-01-01 typed into a date. Each saved value fits its kind, so validation can't catch it, but the user never typed it. Should, because the user sees the saved value in the grid.
object.description: When the user leaves an integer, real or date attribute's editor, the Document Editor should either save the typed value unchanged or refuse the typed value.
